scenario.title: Events, health checks and diagnostic evidence
situations: A user asks what happened or why something stopped.
A project needs a health scan.
Doctor is incomplete or a machine differs from the server.
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Trace live CLI/workbench failure outputs to the precise help/doc targets for each family.
The large public health article mixes operator use with source implementation detail; audience reorganization is already under review.

lessons.title: Use the audit stream with an honest search scope
lessons.when: Investigating a past action or unexpected state
lessons.need: Events holds operational evidence; filter by name/time and understand loaded search versus server filters. An event is evidence of its recorded fact, not a replacement for current domain state.
lessons.surface: Docs index/sidebar -> Events/Doctor/Ouroboros -> documented Events page; Doctor skill points to recent anomalies.

lessons.title: Choose a bounded applicable health scan
lessons.when: A feature seems broken or the user asks for a health report
lessons.need: Read scope first: quick, full or named checks; source/capability/runtime applicability is explicit. N/A is not pass; timeout is incomplete evidence. Deterministic fix is an intentional separate choice.
lessons.surface: Doctor skill -> run/notes; public health page -> run help.

lessons.title: Turn a failure into one focused recovery
lessons.when: A check times out, source is absent remotely, or install just completed
lessons.need: Preserve exact failure/partial result, use the named check recovery and scoped rerun. Remote and local source halves have different authority. The focused install check in E is planned, not the current general Doctor.
lessons.surface: Existing Doctor contract supports named recovery; FIRST-USER E adds install selection and plain next steps.
